# XWhy: eXplain Why

> XWhy is an open-source Python package for model-agnostic local explainability using SMILE.

XWhy explains the local behaviour of machine-learning and generative AI models. Image Classification, Image Generation & Editing, LLM, Tabular, and Text explainers are currently available. Point Cloud remains an under-construction public interface. Time Series, Multimodal, Agentic AI, and Multi-Agent AI are documented research-roadmap capabilities rather than implemented explainers.

Package name: `xwhy`

Install with `pip install xwhy`.

## Official resources

- [XWhy documentation](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/): Official documentation and capability overview.
- [Install XWhy](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/installation/): Installation and optional dependencies.
- [Quick start](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/quick-start/): Current executable explanation workflows.
- [Choose an explainer](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/getting-started/choosing-an-explainer/): Select the correct implemented or planned workflow.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Dependable-Intelligent-Systems-Lab/xwhy): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/xwhy/): Installable Python distribution.
- [Python API reference](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/reference/xwhy/): Generated package reference.

## Explainers

- [Explainer overview](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/): Supported and planned explainers.
- [Image classification](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image/): Available image-classification explainability.
- [Image generation and editing](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/): Available image-generation and image-editing explainability using `ImageGenerationAndEditingExplainer`.
- [Image editing](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/image-editing/): Available instruction-guided image-editing explainability.
- [Pix2Pix-style models](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/image-generation/pix2pix-models/): Pix2Pix as a conditional image-to-image model family within the broader generative-image capability.
- [LLM explainability](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/llm/): Available LLM prompt-response explainability.
- [Tabular](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/tabular/): Available tabular classification and regression explainability.
- [Text](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/text/): Available conventional text-model explainability.
- [Point cloud](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/point-cloud/): Point-cloud explainer development status.
- [Time series](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/time-series/): Time-series explainability roadmap.
- [Multimodal](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/multimodal/): Multimodal explainability roadmap.
- [Agentic AI](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/agentic-ai/): Planned explainability for agent trajectories, planning, retrieval, memory, tool use, state transitions, and uncertainty or failure propagation.
- [Multi-Agent AI](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/explainers/multi-agent-ai/): Planned explainability for agent contribution, inter-agent communication, coordination, disagreement, dependencies, and uncertainty or failure propagation.

## Concepts and responsible use

- [How SMILE works](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/concepts/smile/): The explanation workflow underlying XWhy.
- [Local explanations](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/concepts/local-explanations/): Scope and interpretation of local explanations.
- [Limitations and responsible use](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/concepts/limitations/): Appropriate and inappropriate uses.

## Evaluation

- [Evaluation overview](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/): Modality-aware explanation evaluation.
- [ATT fidelity](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-fidelity/): Fidelity and implemented surrogate metrics.
- [ATT accuracy](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-accuracy/): Attribution accuracy and image coverage functions.
- [ATT stability](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-stability/): Stability under small input changes.
- [ATT consistency](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-consistency/): Consistency across repeated executions.
- [ATT faithfulness](https://dependable-intelligent-systems-lab.github.io/xwhy/evaluation/attribution-faithfulness/): Faithfulness under interventions.
